reviewedBatches.notes: Constrained mechanical trap, local fold stability, fixed-parameter small-probe limit, zero-probe quotient; directed incidence sign, all-subset nullspace, kinematic versus passive realizability and sensor noise assumptions.

Positive fixed-total-charge radial family, referenced potential versus field nullspaces, conditional probe design; separate MQS/distribution ratios, regular Bessel denominator proof, peak phasor energy identity and internal versus full impedance.

Oriented differences, calibrated covariance, gauge reference versus meter bias and correlated noise; periodic smooth potential flux obstruction, nonzero Fourier inverse, constant-potential class and cell-integral error floor.

Staggered time-level invariant, strict Courant bound versus critical Jordan mode and prepared eigenline; periodic compatibility, minimum-field correction, changed effective source and affine energy sign. Plain glyph issue reproduced and corrected without altering equations/code.

Motional/force signs and passive mechanical closure, fixed versus variable inductance and coenergy consistency; finite spatially resolved Fourier observations, blind times, correlated/shared snapshot errors, ridge bias and bandwidth-dependent conditioning.

Power projection versus vector Ampere source, unconstrained real conductivity tensor, PSD passivity and calibrated probe covariance; physical vacuum c0, stress tensor rather than vector, local zero-flux versus null/zero states and arithmetic limits.

Resolved prescribed vacuum dipole sheet versus regular dielectric constitutive model; distributional charge sign and test-function error, fixed moment versus fixed charge energy and Cauchy bound; electric-sheet boundary signs, passive two-port normalization and one-beam bound versus coherent absorption under exact assumptions.

Space-time one-form orientation and electric face curl, filled rectangle exactness versus periodic wrapping and restricted endpoint gauges; weighted quotient is a declared metric, not physical energy. Lorenz derivative residuals, incoming characteristic signs, source-history bound, independent constant mean and polynomial boundary injection versus physical Maxwell radiation.

Passive relaxing RC branch with independent polarization charge, exact storage/loss and positive two-rate dynamics; fast isolated redistribution matching versus finite-R singular limit and noncommuting time limit. Circular aperture Bessel transfer, regular k=0 versus zero area, motional sign, exact root versus rounded input and conditional single-mode inverse with area-scaled physical voltage gain.

Positive Foster LC branches and positive static residual capacitance, separate response and energy tails strictly below first omitted pole, selected sinusoidal versus DC and free initial states; layer order similarity, finite boundary E/H signs, identical-port reflection phase versus power, analytic near-identity logarithm and origin-dependent BCH term, symmetric bulk cut versus changed physical termination.
